integrity.finite_verification: supplementary exhaustive finite cases; not an infinite proof
integrity.proof: algebraic, characteristic-uniform arguments with characteristic cases separated

scientific_limitations: Classification concerns brackets on one fixed four-dimensional commutative algebra, with field-linear equivalence only; it is not a classification of all dimension-four Poisson algebras. The 2025 classification over complex numbers provides prior general methodology and may imply the odd-characteristic normal forms after adaptation. Possible unindexed characteristic-two computations remain a bibliographic risk.
title: Poisson structures on the four-dimensional double-dual-number algebra
